preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in [a, b, c, d])
preconditions.description: Input consists of four non-negative integers a, b, c, d representing counts of 0, 1, 2, 3 respectively.
Total count of numbers (a + b + c + d) is at least 1 and at most 10^5.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' if not exists_sequence(a, b, c, d) else ('YES' in stdout and len(stdout.split()) == a + b + c + d + 1)
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output is exactly 'NO'. Otherwise, first line is 'YES' followed by a valid sequence of length a+b+c+d where counts of 0, 1, 2, 3 match a, b, c, d respectively, and |sequence[i] - sequence[i+1]| == 1 for all 0 ≤ i < len(sequence)-1.

postconditions.expression: all(sequence.count(x) == counts[x] for x in [0, 1, 2, 3]) if 'YES' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the sequence contains exactly a 0s, b 1s, c 2s, and d 3s.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(sequence[i] - sequence[i+1]) == 1 for i in range(len(sequence)-1)) if 'YES' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the sequence is beautiful (consecutive elements differ by exactly 1).
